reason: A web sidebar plugin that displays DeepSeek account balance and aggregated token usage from the official API and local dsh session logs, with today/all-time filtering and theme adaptation.

summaries.zh: 在 dsh 网页侧边栏中显示 DeepSeek 账户余额和按时间范围汇总的令牌用量。
summaries.en: Displays DeepSeek account balance and aggregated token usage in the dsh web sidebar with today and all-time views.

capabilities: Reads the dsh credential used for the DeepSeek API
Calls the DeepSeek official balance endpoint
Reads and decompresses local dsh session logs
Serves usage data through a local HTTP route
Adds a balance and usage panel to the web sidebar
